   156→    /// Includes all signatures on the block (except the deposit signatures and the proposal

   158→    pub fn include_all_signatures_except_proposal<Payload: AbstractExecPayload<E>>(
   159→        &mut self,
   160→        block: &'a SignedBeaconBlock<E, Payload>,
   161→        ctxt: &mut ConsensusContext<E>,
   162→    ) -> Result<()> {

   174→        Ok(())

   177→    /// Includes the block signature for `self.block` for verification.
   178→    pub fn include_block_proposal<Payload: AbstractExecPayload<E>>(
   179→        &mut self,
   180→        block: &'a SignedBeaconBlock<E, Payload>,
   181→        block_root: Option<Hash256>,
   182→        verified_proposer_index: Option<u64>,
   183→    ) -> Result<()> {
   184→        let set = block_proposal_signature_set(
   185→            self.state,

   187→            block,
   188→            block_root,
   189→            verified_proposer_index,

   197→    pub fn include_randao_reveal<Payload: AbstractExecPayload<E>>(

   199→        block: &'a SignedBeaconBlock<E, Payload>,
   200→        verified_proposer_index: Option<u64>,
   201→    ) -> Result<()> {
   202→        let set = randao_signature_set(
   203→            self.state,
   204→            self.get_pubkey.clone(),
   205→            block.message(),
   206→            verified_proposer_index,
   207→            self.spec,
   208→        )?;

   210→        Ok(())
   211→    }

   213→    /// Includes all signatures in `self.block.body.proposer_slashings` for verification.
   214→    pub fn include_proposer_slashings<Payload: AbstractExecPayload<E>>(
